description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Deloitte is hiring a Power Platform Developer to support a U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs client. The role builds and maintains PowerApps applications and Power Automate workflows, supports consular users, and contributes to related data, automation, and AI solutions.
Power Platform Developer building and maintaining consular PowerApps applications, Power Automate workflows, and platform environments with user support.

Responsibilities:
• Design, build, operate and maintain scalable PowerApps-based applications to support routine tasks and operations conducted by consular staff, including conducting user requirements gathering and discovery as needed
• Provide technical support and assistance to consular staff using PowerApps-based applications, including monitoring, and responding to user inquiries and outreach. Implement related de-bugging as needed
• Develop, implement, test, and support PowerApps and Power Automate workflow automations
• Maintain Microsoft Power Platform environment, including related dev, test, and prod applications, data connections, and automations, among other Power Platform elements and features
• Regularly engage with product councils and owners to identify gaps, needs, and user requirements. Collaborate with team members to innovate and propose solutions, drawing on Power Platform-based tools and other technical environments

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of experience working in MS Power Platform with a focus on designing and implementing PowerApps-based applications, including developing effective data models and working in Microsoft environment to implement dev, test, and prod O&M procedures
• Demonstrated knowledge of extended Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Dataverse, and other MSPP features
• Experience providing technical assistance and support, including direct engagement with users in helpful and professional manner
• Effective communication, collaboration, and engagement skills to coordinate with a cross-functional team
• Comfort engaging with users and product councils
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently debug complex data issues
• Familiarity with effective technical documentation, version control and agile development practices
• Comfort working in fast-paced, client-facing environments with evolving priorities
• Bachelor's degree
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
• Active Secret security clearance required

Preferred:
• Familiarity with security and governance considerations in MSPP environments
• Experience building and maintaining dashboards with PowerBI
• Experience using data connectors from Power Platform to other platforms (i.e., Azure data lakes, Azure Databricks, etc.)
• Experience in programming or scripting languages, such as python
• Experience with Co-Pilot Studio
